source: TSTD, comprehensive mung bean cultivation manual, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Mung bean], 2013
text: This comprehensive TSTD mung bean (សណ្តែកបាយ) manual opens with variety selection, profiling CARDI-released varieties and describing recommended traits for Cambodian conditions (short duration, disease tolerance, uniform maturity for easier once-over or few-pass harvest). Farmers are advised to source certified/clean seed each season rather than repeatedly saving seed, since seed-borne disease and declining vigour are flagged as risks with continuous farm-saved seed use.
